correctness.rationale: For all n>=1, QU=0 implies the explicit invertible factor I-UQ, so ker B_n=(I+UQ)ker A. The rank-n perturbation has n distinct output monomials. After backward shifting the graph kernel, the quotient consists of 2n+1 mutually distinct low-degree monomials with 2n+1 independent high-degree input coefficients, establishing exact minimal defect. Eight exact symbolic finite instances pass; the universal quantifier is supplied by the analytical coordinate proof, not by numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: The construction shows a newly published general 2n+1 near-invariance defect bound cannot be lowered at ANY rank, with explicit bounded analytic monomial symbols, exactly rank-n perturbations and linearly growing finite model dimension. This rules out uniform improvements under the core hypotheses and identifies the exact obstruction, rather than proving a routine deduction from the existing upper-bound theorem.
